outcome.Summary: Implemented Parse in cli/cli.go as a hand-rolled parser: long flags (--verbose, --count/--count=, --output, repeatable --tag) and short flags (-v with repeatable booleans, -n/-n=, -o/-o=), handling `--` to end option parsing, lone `-` as positional, and unknown-flag errors. All errors wrap ErrUsage via fmt.Errorf("%w: ...") mentioning the offending flag; defaults are Count=1 and Output="-", with Tags/Args left nil when empty. Verified with the existing TestDefaults plus a temporary table of all rules (including a combined-flag value case and error cases checked with errors.Is), then removed the temp test; `go test ./...` passes.
